definitions.presence: audit_dataset: falsey address/hours; missing-or-vague uses flatkey and its exact established list.
definitions.publisher_vagueness: publisher_quality_matrix._field_problems: broader established VAGUE_ADDRESSES; kept separate from dataset audit.
definitions.specific_address: stored_market_sibling_proposals.safe_stored_street: lexical import suitability, not navigation or source truth.
definitions.clock_interval: happings_detail_layout._intervals: recognized HH:MM pair, not proof of correct or complete daily hours.
definitions.field_receipts: field_evidence.clean_receipts and field_states: exact identity/value/source/read/hash binding; 45-day reads and existing 365/180-day source-age rules.
definitions.source_freshness: source_freshness.source_date_evidence: publisher date remains separate from read/import; existing 540-day threshold.
definitions.dates: Only actual parseable saved dates >= as_of; saved prevista/riportata/confermata labels remain distinct. Instances are unique row/date pairs.
definitions.source_calendar: source_calendar validators: intact identity-bound source list. Current list/date mismatch includes expired dates or explicit confirmation overrides and requires review, not automatic correction.
definitions.provenance_only: Only declared metadata/receipts change; calendar/detail event facts are compared separately. Status, certainty, human-verification timestamp, forecast rule and location fields always count as data changes.
definitions.data_changed: A serialized catalog field changed; this is not a count of corrected venues or newly observed source facts. Consult field counts and calendar_changes before describing the result.
definitions.formats: source_format_audit.classify_url: URL-shape inventory, not a new source read or DOM coverage claim.
definitions.source_truth_limit: No live sources are reread here. A valid saved receipt proves structural/value binding, not independent confirmation of a future market opening.
